source_notes: Representative blue re-verify (dev_pipeline check; GEM LastUpdated 2025-07-17 was 10.5 mo stale). Status remains 'construction' and is CORRECT: as of Jan-Feb 2026 the project is at a standstill, NOT operating. FSRU 'Etyfa Prometheas' is still moored in Malaysia (uncertified for the one-way voyage and not yet FSRU-certified, ~EUR470k/month idle cost); the Vasilikos jetty/land facilities are roughly 50% complete; the China-led CPP-Metron EPC contract was terminated (July 2024); Technip Energies is assessing remaining works; EPPO is investigating for suspected fraud/corruption. No status change to stage (still construction). NOT changing LatestPlannedStartYear (GEM=2026) here — slip is real but no firm verified replacement year exists; see qa note 'status_timeline'.

source_notes: Blank-ref fill for 'Status [ref]' (was blank). This is the cancelled onshore LNG EXPORT/liquefaction plant at Vasilikos (Noble Energy operator, Block 12) — distinct from the Cyprus FSRU import terminal. The Cyprus Ministry of Energy hydrocarbons page documents the onshore LNG Plant as 'currently on hold', citing unsuccessful Block 9 exploration wells and lower Aphrodite reserve estimates after the 2013 appraisal as having undermined viability. This is a primary/regulatory source supporting a not-proceeding/cancelled status (page wording is 'on hold', so confidence yellow rather than green for the hard 'cancelled' label). Ref pairs the existing Status value (no value change). Note: the govt page gives NO specific shelving/cancellation years — the ShelvedYear(2017)/CancelledYear(2019)/StopYear(2019) values are RR's INFERRED values (Substatus 'inferred 4 y'; ShelvedCancelledStatusType 'inferred') and have no clean documenting source, so their [ref] columns are left BLANK rather than orphan-cited; see qa note.
